soldier: Head pale yellow with rather dense short hairs, the tips of the mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head subquadrate, the lateral margins nearly parallel, broader at the middle, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum trapezoidal with its tip concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large tooth before the middle whose tip is directed obliquely forwards, without minute teeth above the base; antennae with 14 segments, the second slightly longer than the third; the waist of the postmentum 0.25–0.28 mm wide, its anterior part with a heart-shaped depression like a spoon; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin concave and depressed.
